# Literature review

This replay fixture runs without a literature search (no references are added to the study). The draft cites no work, and the citation check reports that the study has no references.

The methods are standard (seasonal naive and naive baselines, a regression on a linear trend and monthly means, KPSS and Mann-Kendall diagnostics, hold-out evaluation); the template's method skill names their sources. A real study would situate the Frankfurt trend in regional climate assessments and compare reanalysis with station records; this fixture states only what the study does.
